design.criterion: Preserve at least two-thirds of earlier useful files if there are three or more, require at least two useful files across at least two source photos, and add at most two ordinary flags and one new flagged source group versus the corresponding native JPEG75 controls.
design.delivery: Eleven different photos and eight variants per photo. Final JPEG75 and direct JPEG90 share exact pre-encode RGB and truth. Run the unchanged quality-75 projection and agreement rule from the two-bank trial.
design.sources: All qualifying CC BY 2.0 photos from the archived 12-group first F5 panel. Exclude previously used quality-agreement groups by individual photo, credited photographer and original bytes. One archived source falls below the 512-pixel short-side scope.
